title: Appointed as Assistant
original: Ehi, Doctor, got anything fun to do?

title: Talk 1
original: Tsk, goddamn peppers... I gotta find a way to make them disappear from the canteen forever.

title: Talk 2
original: I heard Yanese got some old sayings similar to 'Catch the moment'. Heh, the line I like. Don't you think it suits me very well? The future? Meh, I'll let Aosta chew on those sorts of things.

title: Talk 3
original: Oi, Doctor, don't just sit there all day. Why don't we have some fun, like… remodeling your whole office?

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: Aosta once said I wouldn't live long like this. At the time, I told him, what's the point of long life if I can't do what I want?

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: Fight for what you want, snatch what you like. I don't know the meaning of the word 'Surrender'!

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: I think up what to do, Aosta thinks up how to do it, and Broca makes sure we get it done together. That's how we've always gotten by, and it's how we ended up here.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: Doctor, what are you doing all frowny-faced over there? If there's anything weighing on you, just lay it on me. I'm good at that sort of stuff.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: Say, Doctor, if someday you decide to quit running Rhodes Island, why not come along with us? Chiave doesn't take orders from anyone, but in your case, I'll make an exception.

title: Idle
original: Ehi, Doctor... You fell asleep? Whatever, I'll be back later.

title: Onboard
original: Yo, are you the Doctor? Hello, and well met. The name's Chiave. Starting today, I'm your goon!

title: Watching Battle Record
original: Whoa-ho-ho... Hey Aosta, check this out! Give me a moment and I'll be even stronger than these guys!

title: Promotion 1
original: Huh? Promotion? What do you mean?

title: Promotion 2
original: Incredible. There are just too many interesting people here at Rhodes Island. How am I supposed to just stay in my seat? I've gotta get stronger and stronger!

title: Added to Squad
original: Ha, here we go!

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: Listen up, everyone, I have a plan!

title: Depart
original: Haha, let's go make some noise!

title: Begin Operation
original: Just gotta knock 'em all down, right?

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: Still not my turn yet?

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: C'mon, don't make me yawn.

title: Deployment 1
original: I can't wait any longer!

title: Deployment 2
original: Haha, I'm gonna end you all!

title: In Battle 1
original: Take this!

title: In Battle 2
original: Hey! Why are you running?!

title: In Battle 3
original: Yeah, yeah, you've all done a great JOB!

title: In Battle 4
original: I'm on FIRE!

title: 4-star Result
original: Hah, now this is the fun stuff!

title: 3-star Result
original: Ah. Where's the challenge in that, Doctor?

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: Huh? I left a few? Never even saw 'em.

title: Operation Failure
original: Shit, for real?!

title: Assigned to Facility
original: ello, bruthas and sistahs!

title: Tap
original: What is it?

title: Trust Tap
original: Yo, Doctor, you're in a pretty good mood.

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: Doctor! Aosta, Broca, and I have a new New Year's plan. Heh heh, once I tell you, you're in on the game. We're going to swap out all the chocolate sauce in the canteen for Siracusan meat sauce, then— Huh? Doctor, where are you going?! Don't you tell Dr. Kal'tsit!

title: Greeting
original: Ehi Doc, did you have a good meal?

title: Birthday
original: Ehi, Doctor, Happy birthday! Ta-dah— Check out this model car. I made it myself. It's yours now. Truth be told, if the conditions were right, I would've built you an actual car. Well, I guess that's a promise. Doctor, come visit me in Siracusa sometime and I'll trade this for a real car.

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: Rhodes Island's got all these heavies, plus smart people like you. One day, someday, I'm gonna do something big that'll rock the whole world! At the very least, I'll do it before I die! Uh, I should try to stay alive...? I guess you're right, haha…
